name: Nonlinear (SNL-IN)
blurb: Pushover, nonlinear response-history analysis (NLRHA) and the direct design method (DDM, GMNIA) on an HR Steel (IS 800) design package, the four-analyses comparison, the IS 1893 elastic target spectrum at DBE and MCE, a design-criteria draft, and feedback loops that hand a re-design back to HR Steel. IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear analysis; results are for information. The module reports response quantities — drifts, ductility demands, hinge rotations against the IS 800 Section 12 deformation capacities (0.02 / 0.04 rad) as reference, base shear against VB, λu — and no verdict.

tabs.title: Run
tabs.blurb: Collect specification values first, then Run analyses: three engines in sequence, each in its own process (openseespy is a process singleton). The HR Steel (IS 800) package is copied into this project folder first, so every output lands beside it. NLRHA scales the suite to the IS 1893 ELASTIC spectrum — DBE = (Z/2)·I·Sa/g and MCE = Z·I·Sa/g, never divided by R — and runs both levels; the DDM takes its combinations from the package's load_plan (IS 875 / IS 1893). IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear analysis; results are for information. Typical times on two cores: pushover 5–15 min, NLRHA 30–90 min, DDM 30–70 min. The design-criteria draft is refreshed at the end of every run.

actions.label: Collect specification values
actions.info: Do this first. It reads the IS values the analyses rely on out of the IS corpus on this PC (engineering_rag_india) with deterministic exact lookups — IS 2062 (Part 1):2025 Table 3 fy / fu for the design's grade, IS 18168:2023 Table 1 Ry / Ru (reference, capacity design), IS 800:2007 Section 12 joint-rotation capacity for the system (0.02 / 0.04 rad, reference only), IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 Table 3 Z, Table 8 I, 6.4.2 Sa/g for the soil type and 7.2.4 damping — has the model copy each value with the cell it came from, checks every quote and number, and writes hinge_params_collected.json into the project. The hinge backbones are in no IS document: they stay modelling assumptions (information / EOR input), never acceptance criteria. Run analyses opens once that file exists; a value the corpus cannot answer is named and Run analyses stays closed.

tabs.title: Review
tabs.blurb: The model reads what the run measured — the IS 1893 elastic DBE / MCE response (drifts against the 7.11.1.1 reference 0.004 h), the pushover curve and mechanism, the DDM system-capacity check (λu), the design-criteria draft — looks up the clauses it cites in the IS corpus (engineering_rag_india: IS 1893, IS 800, IS 18168, IS 2062, IS 808, IS 875), and writes an engineer's review with citations: what the analyses show, the margins, what to change and why. IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear analysis; results are for information, so the review reports response quantities and gives no pass/fail verdict. Its reasoning and its text stream here as it works; the review lands in the project folder.

fields.label: Focus (optional)
fields.placeholder: e.g. Is the storey-3 drift concentration at MCE a mechanism problem or an accidental-torsion artefact? Would deeper columns in the lower two storeys be the cheaper fix?
fields.help: Anything you want the review to concentrate on. Empty = the standard review: response quantities, margins against the IS reference values, mechanism, what to change.

fields.label: Answer from the run alone (do not query the standards)
fields.help: Normally the model grounds every clause it cites in the IS corpus (engineering_rag_india). Tick to skip that (faster; citations then come from the model's memory and are flagged as unverified).

fields.label: Standards searches, at most
fields.help: Leave empty and the review looks up every clause it cites, however many searches that takes. Set a number only to cap the cost of a run.

tabs.title: Feedback
tabs.blurb: Once a run is complete: what the analyses measured, the re-design loops back to HR Steel (resize by system role, mechanism shaping through strong-column/weak-beam and panel zones per IS 800 12.11.3.2 / IS 18168 8.2), the re-design streamed live, the verification with the same analyses, and one button to make a verified candidate the design of record. The design-drift loop is not eligible on India jobs: IS 1893 has no drift-relief provision for nonlinear results. IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear analysis; results are for information.

tabs.title: IS 1893 spectrum
tabs.blurb: The elastic target spectra for the NLRHA suite from IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 + Amd 1/2: DBE = (Z/2)·I·Sa/g and MCE = Z·I·Sa/g for the site's zone (Table 3), soil type (6.4.2) and importance factor (Table 8), never divided by R. Writes nlrha/site_hazard.json (the IS path writes no HTML page; the Run tab and the four-analyses sheet read the JSON). Values default to the package's cfg; set them here to override. Runs offline — no hazard service is called.

tabs.title: Design criteria
tabs.blurb: Draft the design-criteria document for the nonlinear study from the package and whatever analyses exist (IS 1893 spectrum, selected suite, results): governing IS documents, hazard, ground motions, modelling, the linear design basis, open items, the retrieval log. Word (.docx) for mark-up and HTML for the hub. Also written at the end of every Run. IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 provides no acceptance criteria for nonlinear analysis; results are for information.
